section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch17 — RTI Act 2005
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Under the RTI Act, every public authority must designate officials to handle information requests, known as:
explanation: Public Information Officers (PIOs) are designated within each public authority to respond to RTI applications.

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: NEP 2020 recommends that vocational education be integrated into mainstream education starting from which stage?

options.option_text: Class 6 onwards, with internships in local trades
Only after completing a postgraduate degree
Only for students who fail academically
Vocational education is not mentioned in NEP 2020 at all

explanation: NEP 2020 recommends exposing students to vocational skills starting Class 6.

section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch21 — Contemporary Concerns
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 mandates that government-funded educational institutions:

options.option_text: Provide inclusive education to children with disabilities alongside reasonable accommodation
Exclude children with disabilities from mainstream schools entirely
Charge extra fees for children with disabilities
Only admit children without any disability

explanation: The RPwD Act, 2016 mandates inclusive education with reasonable accommodation.
